description: USE WHEN you have an Investment Policy Statement (drawdown tolerance, horizon, liquidity need) and want a portfolio checked against it. Flags a violation when the MEDIAN sustained drawdown exceeds max_drawdown_tolerance (a fraction, e.g. 0.15) or the tolerance is breached in a third or more of paths (the worst path and p90 may lie beyond it; see worst_stress); when time_horizon_years < 3 with a median drawdown of 15% or more; or when material holdings are less liquid than liquidity_need. A hard gate, not a score. Descriptive, not advisory.

holdings.description: Portfolio legs: list of {asset, weight} objects, e.g. [{'asset': 'SPY', 'weight': 0.6}, {'asset': 'TLT', 'weight': 0.4}]. Assets: SPY, TLT, GOLD, BTC (aliases GLD, BTC-USD). Weights are non-negative and normalised to sum to 1; at most 50 legs, no duplicates.
holdings.title: Holdings

liquidity_need.description: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' — violated when material holdings are less liquid than the stated need.
liquidity_need.title: Liquidity Need

max_drawdown_tolerance.description: IPS drawdown tolerance as a fraction, e.g. 0.15 = a -15% maximum acceptable drawdown.
max_drawdown_tolerance.title: Max Drawdown Tolerance

time_horizon_years.description: Investment horizon stated in the IPS; short horizons cannot absorb deep drawdowns.
time_horizon_years.title: Time Horizon Years

name: ips_gate
title: IPS gate — planning-step constraint check (hard gate)
